docs.summary: Lazily generates small thumbnail images for assets. Queues work and generates one thumbnail at a time, a rendered one finishing frames later once its readback arrives. Thumbnails stored as raw RGBA bytes (top-down).
Size in pixels of the square thumbnails generated and stored by this system.

members.name: Enqueue
members.signature: public static void Enqueue(Guid guid, Asset asset, string? sourceFilePath = null)

docs.summary: Queues a thumbnail generation job for the given asset. No-op if the guid is empty, the asset is null, the guid is already queued, or a thumbnail file already exists on disk.

Advances thumbnail generation by one frame. Finishes the job in flight once its pixels arrive, otherwise starts the next queued job, waiting for its asset dependencies to load (up to a time budget). Call once per frame.

members.name: LoadThumbnail
members.signature: public static (int width, int height, byte[] pixels)? LoadThumbnail(Guid guid, string thumbnailsPath)

docs.summary: Load a thumbnail from disk. Returns (width, height, RGBA pixels) or null. The on-disk format is: [width:int32 LE][height:int32 LE][RGBA pixel data]. Legacy files without the header are discarded (they will regenerate).

members.name: DeleteThumbnail
members.signature: public static void DeleteThumbnail(Guid guid, string thumbnailsPath)

docs.summary: Deletes the thumbnail file for the given guid from disk and removes the guid from the queue.
Delete all thumbnail files on disk and clear the queue.

members.name: GetThumbnailPath
members.signature: public static string GetThumbnailPath(Guid guid, string thumbnailsPath)

docs.summary: Returns the full file path for a thumbnail with the given guid, using the .thumb extension.
Gets the number of thumbnail generation jobs currently queued and awaiting processing.
